messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 1.6.5

1.6.5. Cleaning of internal parts The machinery or related product shall be designed and constructed in such a way that it is possible to clean internal parts, which have contained dangerous substances or mixtures without entering them; any necessary unblocking shall also be possible from the outside. If it is impossible to avoid entering the machinery or related product, it shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to allow cleaning to take place safely.

response.text:
machinery or related product | shall be designed to allow | cleaning of internal parts that have contained dangerous substances or mixtures without entering them | "" | it is possible to clean internal parts, which have contained dangerous substances or mixtures without entering them
machinery or related product | shall allow | any necessary unblocking from the outside | "" | any necessary unblocking shall also be possible from the outside
machinery or related product | shall allow | cleaning to take place safely | if entering the machinery or related product cannot be avoided | it shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to allow cleaning to take place safely
